accounting: The archive excludes its active command and mutable ledger. Later validation, cleanup and publication accounting is retained in the final external closing receipt and public resource snapshot.

archive.scope: All retained numerical objects, source snapshots, fixed inputs, predictions, duals, checkpoints and scalar histories plus completed command records; final accounting and later acceptance records supplied separately

availability: The restricted numerical archive and final closing receipt are retained externally alongside the independent data root. Raw arrays and provider data are not distributed in Git.
